title: NO SPECTATOR SEASONS
hookText: The one lie that makes you waste half your life
openLoop: Why every season — from 7 to 85 — still has a job for you

outro.next: The whole 'Kind' series is live now
outro.label: Series finale · Day 5 of 5

recap.title: Every season has an assignment
items: In God's economy there are no spectator seasons
The enemy steals seasons by saying 'this one doesn't count'
If God gave you breath today, He gave you an assignment
You're never too young — and never too old — to be used
Longevity is serving Him faithfully across every season
